info.title: Dossier API
info.description: The Dossier sync + tracking contract. Implement this spec to build a Dossier-compatible backend the extension and web app can point at. Authenticate at POST /api/authenticate, then send the access token as a Bearer token on every protected request; refresh it at POST /api/refresh.

get.description: The builder document; the ETag header is its version for If-Match. 404 if not owned.

put.description: Body {doc, theme?, score?} (score = the BFF-computed Resume Score, stored as sent; 4 KB max, an unknown rulesetVersion is ignored). Requires If-Match with the ETag you loaded: 428 without it, 409 DOC_VERSION_CONFLICT {serverVersion, doc} when stale, 413 DOC_TOO_LARGE over 256 KB, 422 DOC_INVALID {path, message}.

Upsert. 409 DRAFT_CONFLICT when another device saved since baseUpdatedAt (force overrides), 413 DRAFT_TOO_LARGE, 422 DRAFT_INVALID, 422 SENSITIVE_CONTENT. Never touches the profile or the extension's version.

delete.description: Deletes the draft. The persona and everything already confirmed in the profile stay.

get.description: Defaults (admin-configured) until the first save; stored=false says which.

put.description: Autosave target: send the whole panel; 422 on an unknown kind, time or zone.

get.summary: Whether daily job matches are on, and what the last run did

put.summary: Switch daily job matches on or off
put.description: On is Pro-only and matches straight away.
Partial: only the fields sent change. 404 if not owned.

put.summary: Switch emails about interviews and offers on or off

get.description: The application plus events (newest first), notes, interviews, mailCount and inbox suggestions. 404 if not owned.

put.description: Partial update (status/confirm/edits) of one of the current user's applications; 404 if not owned.

delete.description: Delete one of the current user's applications (dismiss a draft); 404 if not owned.

patch.description: Only the fields sent change; null clears nextAction, nextActionAt, resumeId and outcome. Every real change writes a timeline event (source WEB). outcome ACCEPTED sets acceptedAt, DECLINED clears it. 404 if not owned; 422 TRACKER_INVALID for a bad value, SENSITIVE_CONTENT for a never-collected value in nextAction.

put.description: Partial: only the fields sent change (body, pinned). 404 if the application or note is not owned.

delete.description: 404 if the application or note is not owned.

put.description: Partial: only the fields sent change; null clears endsAt, tz, location, interviewer and notes. The outcome is set with POST .../outcome. 404 if not owned.

delete.description: 404 if the application or interview is not owned.

put.description: members.role.set at ORG scope. Body: roleIds[] and primaryRoleId (optional only with one role). Roles added or removed must be within the caller's own permissions (422 ROLE_CEILING {key, scope}); a caller capped at BELOW_ADMIN may not touch OWNER or admin-level roles; nobody changes their own roles; 409 LAST_ADMIN when the organization would lose its last Owner or administrator; 409 SEAT_STATE for a member who has left. org_member.role follows the primary role. 404 for another organization's member or role.

post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a fresh access token AND a fresh refresh token (rotation). The presented refresh token is revoked; reusing it later revokes the whole token family. Returns 401 if the token is missing, expired, tampered, already used, revoked, or is not a refresh token. Clients MUST store the returned refresh token.
Builds a NEW resume from the stored proposal, keeping the named changes.

get.description: Undecided suggestions worth showing now, one per profile field.

post.description: From the extension. Disallowed or malformed entries are skipped; always 204 for a well-formed body.
The same value is never suggested again.
Writes the value (or the posted edit) into the profile.

get.description: All resumes owned by the current user.

post.description: Create a resume owned by the current user (server fills object key, status, createdAt).
Body {hash}: the contentHash that was exported. Sets exportedAt and exportedHash; 404 if not owned, 422 DOC_INVALID for a malformed hash.

Writes the current content as its own version first (unless it already is the newest row), then makes version n the document, theme and (when still enabled) template; the PDF is queued at once. The response carries the new ETag. 404 for a resume that is not yours or a version that is not there.
Queues the PDF job immediately when the stored PDF is behind the document; 204 either way, 404 if not owned.

post.summary: Open an uploaded resume in the builder
post.description: Builds a document from the uploaded resume's parsed structure and makes it BUILT (same id). 409 ALREADY_BUILT when it already is; 404 if not owned.
Same as POST /built with source {kind:'copy', fromResumeId}: the plan cap applies first (402), ids are regenerated, label '<name> (copy)'.
Body {name?}. Writes a MANUAL (or NAMED) version of the saved document and asks for its PDF at once. 404 if not owned or uploaded, 422 DOC_INVALID for a name over 80 characters.
Turns a tailored resume into a master (it keeps its content and job target). 409 NOT_TAILORED otherwise.
Pro. Up to three variants in a tone (concise, confident, plain), as one proposal with ref 'summary'.

get.summary: Open AI suggestion cards of a resume
get.description: No AI call. Cards in carousel order, each marked stale when the resume has changed since; staleAt is when a refresh is due.

post.description: Pro. Up to resume.ai.suggestMax improvement cards (kind, title, body, checked changes) for the document as it is now. The answer for the same document is the stored one at zero cost; refresh=true asks again. Nothing changes until a card is applied.
Pro. Up to resume.ai.rewriteMaxRefs lines by ref, in a mode (stronger, shorter, formal, plain, grammar). The answer is a checked proposal; nothing changes until it is applied.

get.description: {org, grants, links, viewers}: the org row is null when the organisation area is not in play. Expired grants are listed (expired=true) until removed; revoked ones are not. 404 if not owned.

post.summary: Share a resume with a Kiwiply account
post.description: Body {email, role?, expiresAt?, label?}. 404 USER_NOT_FOUND (no active account with that email), 409 ALREADY_GRANTED, 422 ROLE_NOT_AVAILABLE (only VIEW), 422 LIMIT (resume.share.maxGrants), 422 NOT_SHAREABLE (uploaded files), 422 ACCESS_INVALID, 422 SENSITIVE_CONTENT.

Body {expiresAt?, label?, allowDownload?}. The response carries the url. 403 FEATURE_DISABLED (feature.resume_share_links.enabled), 422 LIMIT (resume.share.maxLinks), 422 NOT_SHAREABLE, 422 ACCESS_INVALID.

Creates a BUILT resume (the plan's resume cap applies first: 402 RESUME_LIMIT) from a source: the profile (default), scratch (header from the bio only), an upload (parsed structure; 422 SENSITIVE_CONTENT) or a copy of one of the caller's resumes (404 if not theirs).
Idempotent. Stamps finishedAt, writes onboardedAt when blank, deletes the draft, and returns the completeness and the honest autofill field count.

post.summary: Save a match to the board
post.description: Creates a SAVED application from the posting.

get.description: All sections in (section, position) order, or one section. The first call seeds the profile from the default resume.

post.description: 422 SENSITIVE_CONTENT when a value is one the product never collects.
Listed ids first in the given order, unlisted items after them. 404 for an id that is not yours in this section.

One transaction. Items merge by normalised title + organisation (no duplicates); optional flat bio values (identity, contact, links, headline, summary) overwrite with their provenance. Refused as a whole on a never-collected value.

post.summary: Connect a Gmail with an app password
post.description: Checked against Gmail before anything is stored.

post.summary: Add a suggested job to the board

post.description: Batch upsert (dedup on fieldKey+contextHash, last-write-wins) and return the merged set.

get.description: With none of the query parameters: every application owned by the current user as a plain array, newest update first (the extension's contract). With any of page, size, sort, q, status (comma-separated), company, archived (true|false|all, default false) or ghosted: a page {items, total, page, size, summary}; summary holds the per-tab counts ALL, DRAFT, SAVED, APPLIED, IN_REVIEW, INTERVIEW, OFFER, REJECTED, WITHDRAWN, GHOSTED, ARCHIVED (they follow q and company, not the status/archived filters). size is clamped to the server's maximum; sort is field[,asc|desc] over updatedAt, createdAt, appliedAt, lastEventAt, nextActionAt, company, roleTitle, status (400 SORT_INVALID otherwise).

post.description: Create or update (dedup on externalJobId/jobUrl) one of the current user's applications.
Rewrites of existing bullets and summary, checked for truthfulness.

post.summary: Match my resumes to a tracked application
post.description: Scores every live resume against the application's job description.
{body (required), pinned?}. 422 SENSITIVE_CONTENT for a never-collected value, TRACKER_INVALID / TRACKER_LIMIT for size and count caps; 404 if the application is not owned.

post.summary: Check a resume against a tracked application
post.description: Uses the linked resume when none is named.

{kind: PHONE|VIDEO|ONSITE|TECHNICAL|BEHAVIORAL|PANEL|OTHER, startsAt (ISO-8601), endsAt?, tz? (IANA), location?, interviewer?, notes?}. Writes an INTERVIEW event; does not change the application's status. 404 if the application is not owned.
{outcome: PENDING|PASSED|REJECTED|NO_SHOW}. Writes an INTERVIEW event when it changes. 404 if not owned.

post.summary: Score a resume against an application's job
post.description: Structure checks plus keyword coverage.

action ARCHIVE | UNARCHIVE | STATUS (with status) | STAR | UNSTAR over at most the configured number of ids. Returns {done: [ids], failed: [{id, reason}]}; an id that is not yours is failed NOT_FOUND, not an error.
Writes the kept changes (by ref; alternatives by index) into the resume: marks cleared, version AI_APPLY. 409 PROPOSAL_STALE when the resume changed, 422 PLACEHOLDER_REMAINS, 400 KEEP_EMPTY.

get.summary: List the roles an organization can use
get.description: System templates (organization-independent, read-only) first, then the organization's own roles, each with its permission rows. Any active member. 404 when the organization is not enterprise-roles enabled or the caller is not a member.

post.summary: Create a role (blank, from a template, or a copy of another role)
post.description: roles.manage at ORG scope. Body: name, description?, templateKey? (a system template other than OWNER) or sourceRoleId? (duplicate), permissions? (the whole set: [{key, scope, ceilingRoleKey?, rowFilter?}]). Every row must be within the caller's own permissions (422 ROLE_CEILING {key, scope}); 409 ROLE_NAME_TAKEN; 422 ORG_LIMIT_REACHED. 404 for anyone without the permission, when the roles flag is off, or for another organization's source role.

post.summary: Copy a published version into the draft (does not publish)

post.description: Validates everything, makes the draft live, appends a version, bumps config_version. 409 BRANDING_NOTHING_TO_PUBLISH when the draft equals what is live.

post.summary: Throw the draft away (back to what is live); writes no audit row
Upload a logo, favicon or banner into the draft
post.description: multipart field 'file'. PNG, JPEG or WebP only (magic bytes decide); SVG and anything else -> 415 BRANDING_ASSET_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE; over the size cap -> 413 BRANDING_ASSET_TOO_LARGE; too small -> 422 BRANDING_ASSET_TOO_SMALL; not an image or not square (favicon) -> 422. PNG/JPEG are re-encoded (metadata stripped).

delete.summary: Remove the logo, favicon or banner from the draft

post.description: Revoke the supplied refresh token (and its rotation family) server-side. Always returns 200.

post.summary: Save a job to the board
post.description: Creates (or updates, by the board's dedup) a SAVED application from the stored posting. Returns {applicationId}.

post.summary: Hide a job or a company
post.description: {signal: HIDE|HIDE_COMPANY}. The job (or every job of that company) stops showing in the user's search; hiding a saved job archives its application (archivedApplicationId, for Undo).
For the authenticated user, issue a fresh access + refresh token pair in a NEW rotation family, for the browser extension. Requires a valid access token.
Receives Stripe events. Verified by signature; 400 when it doesn't match, 500 to ask Stripe to retry.
Creates a Stripe Billing Portal session and returns its URL.
Creates a Stripe Checkout Session for the chosen plan and returns its URL.

get.description: 204 if the bearer token is valid, 401 otherwise.

post.description: Exchange username + password for a short-lived access token and a long-lived refresh token.
Exchange a valid mfaToken + emailed code for the token pair.
Issue the normal access + refresh token pair for a demo account. 403 DEMO_DISABLED while the demo is off; 404 for any other login.
Verify a Google ID token and exchange it for our access + refresh tokens (find-or-create by verified email).

get.description: Name, target, tags, primary, lifecycle, role, lineage, visibility, version and PDF state. 404 if not owned.

patch.description: Body {name?, target?, tags?, primary?, starred?, archived?, shareWithOrg?}; only the fields sent change. 422 META_INVALID (blank or over-long name, over-long target, more than 10 tags or one over 24 characters), 409 PRIMARY_REQUIRED (unsetting the primary, or archiving it while other live resumes exist).

Body {theme} (accent, fontPair, spacing, pageSize, dateStyle, showPhoto, fit{mode,target,step}, _touched): bounded fields only, at most 8 KB; 422 THEME_INVALID {path, message}. Does not change the content, writes no version row and bumps doc_version (the ETag).

Body {templateId, theme?}; 422 DOC_INVALID for an unknown or disabled id. Applies the new template's theme defaults to the theme keys the user has not touched (or stores the given theme verbatim), writes a TEMPLATE_SWITCH version row and queues the PDF at once. Does not change the fillable content.

delete.description: Idempotent: 204 whether or not it was already revoked. 404 if the resume or the grant is not yours.

patch.description: Body {allowDownload}: allow or stop PDF download on a live link without changing its address. 404 if the resume, or a live link of it, is not yours; 422 ACCESS_INVALID without allowDownload.

get.description: NONE / DRAFT / FINISHED, the persona, the draft summary (its state only with ?include=state), the dashboard card decision and the completeness thresholds. A dismissed card that comes back is counted once per showing.

patch.summary: Set the persona / act on the dashboard card
patch.description: persona: a string sets it, null clears it, absent leaves it (422 PERSONA_INVALID). card.action: SNOOZE, DISMISS or RESET.

get.summary: One role with its permission rows and its version (ETag)
get.description: The ETag is what edit and delete expect as If-Match.

delete.description: roles.manage at ORG scope, If-Match required. 409 ROLE_IN_USE {count} while a live member holds it; 409 ROLE_SYSTEM for a template; 422 ROLE_CEILING when the role holds anything the caller does not.

patch.summary: Rename a role or replace its permission set
patch.description: roles.manage at ORG scope. If-Match: the version (ETag) the editor last saw: 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED without it, 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED {currentVersion} when stale. A system template is 409 ROLE_SYSTEM (clone it first). Everything in the role, before and after, must be within the caller's own permissions (422 ROLE_CEILING {key, scope}).

Body: any of primary, secondary, accent (#rrggbb, white text must reach 4.5:1 -> 422 BRANDING_COLOR_LOW_CONTRAST with a suggestion), theme, welcomeTitle, welcomeMessage, supportEmail, terminology, navPrefs; null clears a field. If-Match: the draftVersion the editor last saw (409 BRANDING_DRAFT_CONFLICT when stale).

get.summary: Public view of the tenant for the forwarded host
get.description: No authentication. The tenant is derived from X-Kiwiply-Host (set by the web BFF), never from a parameter. TENANT: {kind, displayName, branding, login}; PLATFORM: {kind:"PLATFORM"}; an unserved host, a missing header or enterprise being off: 404. Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, Vary: X-Kiwiply-Host. 429 over the per-host-and-IP rate limit.

get.summary: Demo members of the tenant on this host
get.description: X1.12. On a demo tenant's host while DEMO_ENABLED and ENT_DEMO_SEED are on: the members the login page can open, with their role names. Anywhere else {enabled:false, accounts:[]}. No passwords.

get.summary: A published branding asset of the tenant for the forwarded host
get.description: kind = logo | favicon | banner. No authentication; the tenant comes from X-Kiwiply-Host only. 404 for a host that is not served, an unknown kind or an unset asset. Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400; ETag = the content hash; If-None-Match -> 304; X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

No authentication. The page content only: {name, doc, templateId, theme, allowDownload, pdfReady}. Writes an anonymous LINK view event. 404 for an unknown, revoked or expired link, 429 over the public rate limit.

get.summary: Download the PDF behind a resume share link
get.description: No authentication. 404 unless the link allows download, 409 PDF_NOT_READY while the stored PDF is not current. Writes an anonymous LINK view event.
Whether demos are on, and which accounts the login page can open. No passwords.
A short fingerprint of the current user's bio + resumes. Changes whenever a pull of either would change. Never 404.
Newest first; limit defaults to 50 (1-200). Owner views are not recorded; link viewers are anonymous.
The first page of the stored render, taken by the PDF job. ETag = the render hash; 304 on a matching If-None-Match. 404 when the resume is not yours, is an uploaded file, or has no thumbnail yet.
Owner only. 404 when the resume was not made from an upload or the file is gone.
The master (the resume itself for a master), its tailored children, and this resume's role.
Newest first: {versionNo, reason, name, createdAt, contentHash, by, kind (auto|named|checkpoint|system)}.
The ATS text of one version, for Compare. 404 if there is no such version.

get.summary: Get a resume document as plain text
get.description: text/plain rendering of the visible parts of the document.

get.summary: Get the state of a resume's stored PDF
get.description: NONE | PENDING | RUNNING | READY | FAILED | STALE (READY but behind the document); 404 if not owned.
Fifteen structure checks; no AI.

get.summary: Open AI proposals of a resume
get.description: No AI call. Each proposal says whether the resume has changed since (stale).

get.summary: Export a resume shared with me
get.description: format=pdf: the stored PDF (409 PDF_NOT_READY while it is not current); writes a view event. 404 unless I may read it.

get.summary: Read a resume shared with me
get.description: Read-only, scrubbed document, no ETag; writes a view event. 404 unless I may read it.
Web only: resumes where I hold a USER grant, plus (when the org area is in play) those of members who gave me FULL scope.
Limits, score weights, templates, feature switches, plan and resume cap for the signed-in user. ETag = sha256 of the body; Cache-Control private, max-age=60.
A {key: parsed|user|learned} map for the flat bio values; empty when none is recorded. Kept off GET /api/profile, which the extension reads.

get.summary: The latest notifications and how many are unread
My interviews in a date range
get.description: Soonest first, each with its application's company and role. from/to are ISO-8601 instants or dates (a date `to` includes that day, UTC); default: from now for the configured number of days. Optional outcome filter (e.g. PENDING, to find interviews awaiting a result). 422 TRACKER_INVALID for a bad or too-wide range.

get.summary: Export an interview as a calendar file
get.description: text/calendar (iCalendar) with a VTIMEZONE for the interview's zone (UTC when none); attachment named interview-<id>.ics. 404 if not owned.

get.summary: Jobs the mail shows that the board doesn't track

get.description: All learned field answers owned by the current user.
Score out of 100, the parts and their weights, and the highest-weight missing part as nextAction.
One row per day for the last N days (default and cap are settings), oldest first, quiet days as 0: [{day: yyyy-MM-dd, count}]. Days are named in tz (an IANA zone, default UTC).

{range, granularity: week|month, real, stats{applied, appliedPrev, replies, interviews, offers, responseRate?}, overTime[{start, applied, interviews, offers}], byStatus[{status, label, count}], inboxSeen, responseByCompany[{company, applied, replied}]}. Counts are applications by the first time they reached each stage, over the last `range` days (default and cap are settings). `real` is false until the account has applied anywhere. responseByCompany is empty until a reply has come through the user's inbox. Days are named in `tz` (an IANA zone, default UTC).

get.summary: The data of the Roles and Permissions page
get.description: Every role the organization can use with its scope label (System or Custom), assigned users, status and version; the custom and system role counts; and the permission overview by category (Core Platform, Recruiting, Consultants, Finance, Administration). Any active member; 404 when the roles flag is off.

get.summary: Published values, the draft, its version and the publish history
Check a colour for the live preview
get.description: Can white text be read on this colour (WCAG AA 4.5:1)? When not, the nearest colour that can. Query: primary, secondary, accent (each optional).

get.summary: The shell's session contract on a tenant host
get.description: Tenant hosts only, with a token minted for that tenant (tid). Returns the organization, the caller's seat and roles, their permission map, the eight module booleans, the workspaces they may open with their navigation (already filtered by their permissions and the organization's modules), the landing workspace, their consent scope and licensed features. ETag / If-None-Match supported (304). 403 MEMBER_SUSPENDED for a suspended member (no organization data); 404 for a platform or unknown host, enterprise off or a non-member; 401 for a token that is not for this tenant (none, personal or another organization's).
The card plus the description (plain text), links, how many other postings that company has and similar jobs. 404 unknown; 410 when it was tracked and has been purged.
Up to jobs.suggest.max distinct titles starting with (or having a word starting with) q; empty under jobs.suggest.minChars letters.

q (words AND-ed, "quoted phrases", -exclude), loc, remote (ANY|REMOTE|HYBRID|ONSITE), type (CSV of FULL_TIME|PART_TIME|CONTRACT|INTERNSHIP), posted (days; one of the jobs.search.postedDays setting), company (prefix), sort (best|newest), page, size (capped by jobs.search.maxSize). Answers {items, total, page, size, capped, tookMs, facets{remote, type, postedBuckets}, suggestions[{label, params, total}]}; Pro cards carry the nightly match. Never lists a job the user hid or applied to. explain=1 adds each result's ranking terms for an admin.
{orgs, demo, enterprise}: whether organization features, the demo accounts and the enterprise master flag are on. No authentication; cached for 5 minutes; never per-user.
Plan, status, renewal date and whether billing is configured. Free when there's no subscription.
This month's AI meter: a percent of the budget (Pro) or a parse count (Free).

delete.description: Removes the HIDE / HIDE_COMPANY signal (a company hide lifts every job of that company). Quietly succeeds when there is none.

hash.description: Render hash of the stored PDF (null when there is none).

generatedAt.description: When the stored PDF was generated.

pollMs.description: Editor endpoints only: milliseconds between status polls.

pollWindowMs.description: Editor endpoints only: how long after the last save to keep polling, in milliseconds.

doc.description: The ResumeDocument (schema v2; a stored v1 document is upgraded on read).

schemaVersion.description: The schema of 'doc' - always 2 (the current ResumeDocument schema).

theme.description: Theme overrides (colors, font, spacing); {} for the template defaults.

renderHash.description: Hash of what the PDF would be rendered from now: sha256(contentHash|templateId|canonical theme). The stored PDF is current when pdf.hash equals it.

score.description: The last Resume Score the editor's server-side scorer stored (DESIGN 11.5); null until the first scored save.

state.description: The web's SetupState (candidates, decisions, cursor); never the file or the raw text.

hash.description: The content hash of the document that was exported (ResumeDocDTO.contentHash).

name.description: Optional name for this version (at most 80 characters); without it the checkpoint is unnamed.

email.description: The email of a Kiwiply account.

role.description: VIEW (the default); EDIT is not available yet.

expiresAt.description: When the grant ends; omitted = it does not expire.

label.description: A note for yourself, at most 80 characters.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working; omitted = resume.share.linkDefaultDays from now (0 = never).

label.description: A note for yourself, e.g. 'Sent to recruiter at Acme' (at most 80 characters).

allowDownload.description: May the holder download the PDF? Omitted = resume.share.allowDownloadDefault.

templateId.description: An enabled template id (setting resume.templates.enabled); the configured default (modern) when omitted.

target.description: Free label for the role this resume targets (meta.target).

label.description: The resume's name; defaults by source: the target / 'My resume', the file name, '<from> (copy)'.

source.description: Where the content comes from: 'profile' (default), 'scratch', {kind:'upload', structured, bio?, fileName, keep?} or {kind:'copy', fromResumeId}.

theme.description: Optional exact theme to store instead of the template defaults (the editor's undo/redo of a switch).

allowDownload.description: May the holder of this link download the PDF?

persona.description: student | first_job | switching | experienced, or null to clear.

scope.description: NONE | SUMMARY | FULL: what the member lets their organisation see.

pairedWith.description: The paired marketer / coach, when there is one.

shareWithOrg.description: This resume's 'include with my organisation' switch.

shareLinks.description: Share links are on (feature.resume_share_links.enabled); the header hides Shared with Recruiters when off.

weights.description: {skills, title, years, industry, education}; sums to 100.

stepSeconds.description: Step key (hello, source, review, skills, you, prefs) to seconds.

copy.description: Copy deck key to a string or an array of strings.

onboarding.description: Onboarding v2 tunables (R1.8): the dashboard card, the time estimates, the draft cap, the payoff.

bands.description: Bands [{min, title, body}], highest min first.

overrides.description: Per-template partial TemplateCapabilities; may only tighten.

popular.description: Template ids in the order the Popular Templates strip shows them first (resume.templates.popular).

bearer-jwt.description: JWT access token issued by POST /api/authenticate (or refreshed via POST /api/refresh).
